1 ORAL ORDER:
Heard Sri V.Vinod K Reddy, Learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner and Sri K. Arjun Chowdhary,
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue.
2. Sri V.Vinod K Reddy, Learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner would submit that the Writ Petitioner is an affected party in the land acquisition proceedings under Somasila Project.

He has drawn attention of this Court to proceedings issued by the Department of Revenue bearing D.Dis.No.616/2009 dated 24.11.2009 (Ex.P1), wherein at Sl.No.4, the name of the father of the Writ Petitioner (Sri Matli Narayana Reddy) is mentioned.

It is stated that the name of the father of the Writ Petitioner, which is at Sl.No.4, is one out of thirty-two (32) displaced persons from Gattupalle Village of Gopavaram Mandal of Kadapa District, which was submerged under Somasila Project.

3. Learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner, however, does not have any information whether any compensation has been paid or whether alternative land has been allotted in lieu of the land (which the Writ Petitioner or Petitioner's father) has lost.

He has drawn attention of this Court to the Photographs to indicate that the Writ Petitioner has occupied an extent of Ac.4.50 Cents in Sy.No.1 of Nellorepalem Revenue Village, Atmakur Mandal, SPSR Nellore District.
4. Learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner has drawn the attention of this Court to the photographs in Ex.P4 to indicate that there is a plantation of eucalyptus trees in the subject land.
5. Sri K. Arjun Chowdhary, Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue has submitted the Written Instructions furnished by the Tahsildar, Atmakur Mandal, SPSR Nellore District dated 10.02.2025.
A copy of it is served on the Learned Counsel for the Writ Petitioner as well.
This Written Instruction is taken on record.

6. It is stated at para-3 of Sl.No.9 of the Written Instructions that the Writ Petitioner has encroached an extent of Ac.4.50 Cents in Sy.No.1 of Nellorepalem Revenue Village, without the permission of the concerned authorities.

It is also stated that the encroached portion of land (Ac.5.50 Cents in Sy.No.1) is classified as Grazing Poramboke land and therefore, no one is allowed to cultivate such land since the same is required to be allotted for Grazing purposes in public interest.

It is also stated that the Respondent No.4 has initiated summary proceedings for evicting the Writ Petitioner under Sections 7 and 6 of AP Land Encroachment Act, 1905 and had sent notices through the concerned Village Revenue Officer.

It is also stated that since the address of the Writ Petitioner has not been traced out, the Official Respondents have erected notice issued under Section 7 of the AP Land Encroachment Act, on the land which is now under occupation by the Writ Petitioner.
7. It appears that the Writ Petitioner's land has been acquired for Somasila Project in the year 2009.

The facts on record would not indicate whether the Writ Petitioner was paid compensation in view of the loss of land and whether the Writ Petitioner was deprived of any land and what is the extent of land.
It is not stated whether the Writ Petitioner was allotted any alternate piece of land in lieu of the land lost by him.

The Written Instructions furnished by the Official Respondents would indicate that the Writ Petitioner owns an extent of Ac.9.25 Cents patta land and therefore, he is not M.Surendra Reddy, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82936485/
2 categorized as poor or land less person belonging to the 'Above Poverty Line Category' (APL category).
8.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Since this Court has noticed that there is a standing eucalyptus crop, this Court is of the opinion that the Writ Petitioner should be allowed to harvest the eucalyptus plantation within a reasonable time and thereafter vacate such land in view of the fact that the Writ Petitioner has not been able to show any evidence that the land which is presently under his occupation has been allotted to him by the Government.

9. In this view of the matter, the Writ Petitioner is directed to file an Affidavit of Undertaking indicating the reasonable time within which he will harvest the entire eucalyptus plantations and vacate from the encroached land.
Let the affidavit be filed within one week from today.
The Writ Petitioner is also free to approach the Authorities for allotment of any land in view of the land lost by him if the compensation is not paid to him.

10. List the matter on 17.02.2025 in the motion list.
11.
In this view of the matter, there shall be a direction to all the parties to maintain Status-quo obtaining as on today, until the next listing.
12. It is clarified that this Interim Order shall not preclude the Writ Petitioner from carrying on with any agricultural activities, insofar as the maintenance of eucalyptus is concerned.

GANNAMANENI RAMAKRISHNA PRASAD, J Dt: 10.02.2025 SNI M.Surendra Reddy, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82936485/
